summary: Makes its child subtree draggable along X and/or Y, reporting position and drag signals, with animated snap-to-position.
description: Drag is a visual container: whatever you place inside it can be dragged with the pointer. `axis` restricts movement ('x' by default, 'y' or 'both'), `enabled` turns dragging on/off, and `useParentBounds` (Constrain to parent, default true) keeps the content inside its parent's box. While dragging, `positionX`/`positionY` (Drag X/Y) hold the current offset in pixels and `deltaX`/`deltaY` the per-move change; `onStart` (Drag Started), `onDrag` (Drag Moved) and `onStop` (Drag Ended) are signals bracketing the gesture. The position can also be driven from the graph: setting `inputPositionX`/`inputPositionY` (Start Drag X/Y) moves the content and updates the outputs, and the `snapToPositionX.do`/`snapToPositionY.do` signals animate to `snapToPositionX.value` over `snapToPositionX.duration` milliseconds (default 300).
whenToUse: Sliders, swipeable cards, drawers, reorder handles — any direct-manipulation gesture where you need the live drag offset. For scrolling content use a Group with scrolling enabled instead; for purely programmatic motion use an Animation on a node's Pos X/Y rather than a Drag no one touches.

ports.axis: Enum value: 'x' (default), 'y' or 'both' — which axes the pointer can move the content along.
ports.useParentBounds: Boolean value (Constrain to parent, default true); keeps the dragged content within the parent element's bounds.
ports.inputPositionX: Number value (Start Drag X); writing it repositions the content programmatically and re-emits `positionX`/`deltaX`.
ports.scale: Number value (default 1); set it when the drag area is visually scaled so pointer movement maps 1:1 to position.
ports.snapToPositionX.do: Signal; animates the X position to `snapToPositionX.value` over `snapToPositionX.duration` ms. Starting a new drag cancels the animation.
ports.positionX: Number value (Drag X): current X offset in pixels; keeps its last value after the gesture ends.
ports.deltaX: Number value (Delta X): change in X since the previous drag event — useful for velocity-style logic.
ports.onStop: Signal (Drag Ended); fires when the pointer releases — the usual place to decide whether to snap back or snap to a slot.

patterns: Snap back: `onStop` → `snapToPositionX.do` with `snapToPositionX.value` 0 — released content animates home.
Swipe threshold: `positionX` → Expression/Condition deciding on `onStop` whether to snap to the open or closed position.
antiPatterns: Rebuilding a scroll view out of Drag — a Group with scrolling enabled handles momentum, wheel and touch for free.
